title: Casten, Lieu propose whistleblower program for prediction market insider trading
summary: Reps. Sean Casten (D-Ill.) and Ted Lieu (D-Calif.) introduced new legislation Friday to regulate prediction markets and prevent insider trading, allowing whistleblowers to come forward and report wrongdoing. The Policing Insider Trading in Prediction Markets Act would create a program at the Justice Department for people with knowledge of insider trading to come forward and...
